name: Ricardo Alvarez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport security began unconventionally. After a stint in the Buenos Aires police force specializing in crowd control, he recognized a need for more robust security measures at local racing events. He transitioned into private security, quickly building a reputation for his meticulous planning and no-nonsense approach. His expertise caught the eye of smaller racing teams, and eventually, Anderson Racing. 

Ricardo believes in preventative security, focusing on identifying and mitigating potential threats before they escalate. He's known for his rigorous training programs for security personnel and his insistence on adhering to the strictest safety protocols. What sets Ricardo apart is his deep understanding of both security tactics and motorsport culture; he can anticipate the unique challenges presented by the high-pressure environment of racing.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo has a strong, square jaw and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with security checklists.
Insists on arriving at the track at least four hours before any event.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against the table when deep in thought.
